tb21_profile.skill: Download and run a named HuggingFace transformer locally, then wrap it in an HTTP service that honours an exact JSON request/response contract (including a 400 error body) and stays alive in the background.
tb21_profile.domain: Python ML serving: HuggingFace transformers/torch on CPU, Flask/WSGI, local model caching, host/port binding.
tb21_profile.task_form: Configure-a-service / implement-from-spec: install deps, build the service, run it detached, verified by live HTTP calls against the schema.

verifier_notes: machine-learning_20260415_094424_003 (DistilBERT CPU deployment) and task_13544 (train a Spark MLlib model and serve it as a REST API) are the two closest structural matches in their corpora but the packet grades both FREE, so they stay in per_source only. machine-learning_20260509_111805_003 (ONNX quantization of a sentiment classifier) is FREE in the packet too and was left out entirely. No grade looked wrong on inspection for this task; the strong grades on software-engineering_20260612_191200_020 and debugging_20260416_184513_003 are earned - those suites issue real HTTP requests and compare bodies. NOTE ON GRADES: work/verifier_strength.json was regenerated after work/packets_v2 was built and the two disagree on ~27% of shown candidates (844 of them flip into or out of FREE). Where they disagree I treated a candidate as FREE if EITHER source calls it FREE, so nothing in final_top10 is FREE under either file.

notes: TMax is unusually strong here: it holds the only tasks in the whole pool that combine a real HuggingFace model download with serving it over HTTP (the whisper-tiny family). CalibForge contributes the best-verified Flask/service-contract tasks and the only genuine sentiment-model deployment work. Terminal-Lego contributes clean, well-graded HTTP status-code and JSON-body tasks. SWE-Rebench is weak: transformers itself appears only as training-side feature requests; bentoml/caikit are the only serving-runtime entries. TerminalWorld is mostly client-side curl-the-running-API tasks and adds little.
